obligations.summary: BlobDigest canonical SHA-256 encoding and JSON round trip pass.
Malformed algorithm, digest, hex and byte-count forms fail closed.
Partition construction is fixed-width, domain separated and has no public business-string initializer.
Same digest in two partitions has isolated visibility and removal authority.
Staged bytes remain invisible to read and physicalID before publish.
Publish has one terminal transition and duplicate publish returns transaction conflict.
Discard is idempotent and a discarded stage cannot later publish.
Duplicate verified commit in one partition reuses one physical blob.
Equal digest in different partitions creates distinct physical blobs.
Store recomputes and verifies digest before publication.

Eleven exact child-process exit points and a three-round 78-case fixed-seed random SIGKILL campaign recover only complete miss or verified hit states; three real mounted-APFS full-volume and three real APFS quota cases additionally preserve old state or converge after storage exhaustion.
Future manifest, pointer and descriptor schemas fail closed and remain unmodified.

Exact and random process termination, a real permission transition, full mounted-APFS exhaustion and APFS quota exhaustion remove unpublished blobs and durable temporary files on reopen while preserving published blobs.
Generation directory, descriptor, staged pointer and published pointer switch points recover to one complete compatible generation.
External delete, truncate and same-length digest corruption produce quarantine and later miss.
Symlink, hardlink, wrong file type, unsafe mode and live parent-directory permission transition tests pass; owner checks exist in code but a different-owner fixture is not produced locally.
Physical locator is a typed UUID and cannot carry a path string.
Reference count, referenced-byte totals and direct directory entry counts fail before mutation or unbounded collection; a retained low-limit overflow fixture exercises the POSIX enumeration bound.

Three retained macOS workloads report process and logical-I/O metrics; three mounted-APFS full-volume and three APFS quota cases qualify two distinct storage-exhaustion modes. Physical I/O, stable-device and energy evidence remain absent.
Same-process registry and kernel lockf exclusion pass; external lock probe fails while writer is active and succeeds after release.
Concurrent readers in one store instance return stable bytes; no multi-process reader guarantee is claimed.
Fovea ContentID to BlobDigest adapter equivalence is not implemented.
Fovea record publication failure and orphan composition test is not implemented.
Fovea revoke versus late publication composition test is not implemented.
Fovea nonpersistent final delivery under cache write failure is not implemented against the independent package.
Adversarial custom-store host identity test is not implemented.

MemoryCache matches an independent SIEVE model across 32 deterministic 800-step traces including limit changes, and a 16-worker generated commuting concurrent history matches its reference final state.
Purge and atomic cost-limit changes report exact removed item and byte cost, expansion removes nothing, contraction follows SIEVE state, and oversized entries remain rejected.
Independent Core, Memory and Disk imports pass in an external consumer; the public symbol baseline and source boundary pass, while a retained negative consumer cannot access package-only crash hooks.
Released current/previous Fovea and Akashic compatibility matrix cannot exist before stable release identities.
